plan.purpose: Separate wide-cache admission interference from lack of arithmetic sharing in the fixed Phi-basis / Prosperity signed-residual fusion.
plan.single_shared_wide_port: All B/R reads and writes are serial events on the same physical 1RW address space; the split gives no additional port.
plan.shadow_policy: Cold per tile, LRU on actual shadow insertion/exact occurrence and selected compatible touch. Query the prior shadow snapshot before inserting current R. Cache nonzero signed masks with popcount >=2 only. Saturate count at 3. Record all scans/comparisons and metadata updates.
plan.all_policy: Admit every newly formed residual with >=2 terms; exact wide hits do not rewrite.
plan.exact_second: If current nontrivial R already occurred in the prior shadow table, admit its completed value after normal construction, including construction from an existing wide parent. Otherwise only update the narrow shadow table.
plan.compatible_second: Strict extension of exact_second. Keep its complete-R admission. Only if exact_second would not admit and no wide residual parent exists, choose the largest proper same-sign subset P in the prior shadow table (lexicographic positive/negative-mask tie), build P in Reg2, write P, then append R-P without another residual write. At most one residual materialization per row. Hold Reg2 until P write completes. Tag updates happen after this decision.
plan.base_policy: Identical to the sealed model: admit fetched/constructed nontrivial bases; one static largest proper subset-center parent, used only when already resident; no recursive parent construction.
plan.wide_replacement: Actual reads and new writes update LRU. Partitioned policies evict only within their B or R allocation; common policies share one LRU. Tag probes are not wide reads.
plan.oracle_boundaries: C128 is only a capacity relaxation of the same native order, centers and parent rule. Future-unused-write elision deletes writes never read later in that same no-eviction trace; it is an unrealizable diagnostic lower bound for that trace, not a fair implementation or global optimum.
plan.strong_baseline: Original full-tile Prosperity clean-room subset relation with official artifact minimum-index tie, popcount/index topological order and live-parent writes. Count its arithmetic, unique coefficient identities, reads, writes and peak live state; different scheduling is disclosed, not an iso-area cycle claim.
plan.numeric_check: Reuse sealed eight-lane INT8-weight / non-1 rational-threshold diagnostics. Verify full destination result, not only residual. No checkpoint FP32 or AEE claim.
plan.gate: Do not advance the fixed routing as a headline based solely on beating a weakened independent-residual baseline. If even the capacity relaxation loses original Prosperity arithmetic, cache policy cannot establish its arithmetic advantage on this cohort. Event counts are not cycles, PPA or RTL speedup.

limits: Native stream versus full-tile planning has different scheduling state; no iso-area or cycle claim.
Tag comparisons are logical valid-entry comparisons, not energy or latency. Physical CAM comparisons can be larger.
Unique coefficient IDs are counted independently per tile under its fixed weight/threshold identity; neither coefficient reads nor unique IDs are external bytes.
Future-unused-write elision is only an offline diagnostic for the same C128 trace.
PWP offline construction and Phi parallel eight-input units remain separate costs, not a scalar runtime proxy.
Non-1 rational diagnostic theta is not a measured checkpoint amplitude distribution or frozen FP32 equivalence.
